# YAMNet

Unmodified source and class map from Google's TensorFlow Models repository,
commit `930a6f98f7debcc32ca7afbca4a176dbf9211e03`, under Apache 2.0.
The copyright headers and full LICENSE are retained.

Source: https://github.com/tensorflow/models/tree/930a6f98f7debcc32ca7afbca4a176dbf9211e03/research/audioset/yamnet

Weights are downloaded separately from the official URL:
https://storage.googleapis.com/audioset/yamnet.h5

SHA-256: `13c3308955bbfaef262f175ac9c40e47b134573a93984f009220dd7cc12a1744`

TensorFlow runs in `.venv-audio`, independently of the app's MLX environment.
The application never downloads weights during processing.
